items.text_th: แล้วแอพGlobal ยังเล่นได้ไหมครับ? คือล่าสุดไปเที่ยวญี่ปุ่น แอพVNGมันเด้งออกบอกให้เปลี่ยนไปเล่นแอพGlobal พอเปลี่ยนไปเล่นGlobal มันย้ายserver ไปอยู่East Asiaให้เองอีก เปิดVPNก็เล่นไม่ได้
items.text_vn: Vậy app Global còn chơi được không ạ? Gần đây mình đi du lịch Nhật, app VNG tự văng ra và báo đổi sang app Global, đổi sang Global thì máy chủ lại tự chuyển sang East Asia, bật VPN cũng không chơi được.
items.text_en: Can the Global app still be played? I recently traveled to Japan; the VNG app kicked me out and told me to switch to the Global app, then Global moved my server to East Asia automatically, and even with a VPN I can't play.
items.summary_vn: Du lịch Nhật không vào được app VNG, chuyển sang Global bị đổi máy chủ East Asia, hỏi Global còn chơi được không (admin: chưa rõ, Global không còn hỗ trợ).
items.summary_en: Traveling in Japan, the VNG app kicked them out and Global moved them to the East Asia server; asks if Global still works (admin: unclear, no support).
items.theme: Đăng nhập tài khoản
items.topic: Login / Account / Data

items.text_en: If you like lots of Power, take power2 success2 Legend1 (or power2 suc3) and drop Tension.
items.summary_vn: Gợi ý chọn chỉ số cần câu: ưu tiên Power, bỏ Tension.
items.summary_en: Suggests rod stats: favor Power and drop Tension.
